site.name: list_collections
site.description: List all collections in the LumiBase site.

site.name: get_collection
site.description: Get a collection with its compiled schema (all fields, system fields, meta).

site.name: create_collection
site.description: Create a new collection. Name must be lowercase snake_case (e.g. "blog_posts"). storageMode defaults to "jsonb" (recommended for most use-cases). primaryKeyType defaults to "nanoid".

site.name: update_collection
site.description: Update metadata on an existing collection (label, icon, note, accountability, etc.).

site.name: delete_collection
site.description: Delete a collection and all its items. DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone. You MUST pass confirm=true explicitly after warning the user.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm destructive operation

site.name: diff_schema
site.description: Preview what would change if you applied a schema update. Returns added/modified/removed fields and any risky changes. Always call this before apply_schema to check for breaking changes.

site.name: apply_schema
site.description: Atomically apply a schema migration to a collection (add/update/remove fields and relations). Call diff_schema first to preview changes. Pass confirmRiskyChange=true on field inputs that have risky changes.

site.name: list_fields
site.description: List all fields in a collection, including system fields.

site.name: upsert_field
site.description: Create or update a field in a collection. field_name must be lowercase snake_case (e.g. "published_at"). Common types: string (varchar), text (longtext), integer, boolean, dateTime, json, uuid. Common interfaces: input, textarea, datetime, toggle, select, file, markdown.

type.description: Storage type: string, text, integer, bigInteger, float, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, time, timestamp, json, uuid, csv, hash, geometry, alias

interface.description: UI widget: input, textarea, select, toggle, datetime, file, image, repeater, relation-m2o, relation-o2m, relation-m2m, code, markdown, wysiwyg, …

renameFrom.description: Previous field name if this is a rename operation

migrationPlan.description: Data migration plan for a risky type change (see diff_schema).

confirmRiskyChange.description: Set true to confirm type-change or destructive migration

site.name: delete_field
site.description: Delete a field from a collection. Data stored in this field will be lost. Pass confirm=true to confirm the destructive operation.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm destructive operation

force.description: Force deletion even if risky (foreign keys, etc.)

site.name: list_items
site.description: List items from a collection with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

sort.description: Comma-separated field names; prefix with - for descending (e.g. "-created_at")

site.name: get_item
site.description: Get a single item by ID from a collection.

site.name: create_item
site.description: Create a new item in a collection.

data.description: Field values for the new item

site.name: update_item
site.description: Partially update an item (PATCH — only provided fields are changed).

site.name: delete_item
site.description: Soft-delete an item (sets deleted_at, recoverable). Pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm deletion

site.name: list_relations
site.description: List all relations configured in the schema.

site.name: create_relation
site.description: Create a relation between two collections (m2o, o2m, m2m, or m2a). Schema-changing operation.

manyCollection.description: Collection that holds the foreign key (the "many" side).

manyField.description: Field on manyCollection that stores the relation.

site.name: delete_relation
site.description: Delete a relation by id. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: list_presets
site.description: List presets for the current site.

site.name: get_preset
site.description: Get a single preset by id.

site.name: create_preset
site.description: Create a new preset.

site.name: update_preset
site.description: Update an existing preset (partial PATCH).

site.name: delete_preset
site.description: Delete a preset. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: get_effective_preset
site.description: Resolve the effective default view for a collection (user > role-chain > global precedence).

site.name: list_preset_bookmarks
site.description: List the named preset bookmarks visible to the principal for a collection (with scope).

site.name: list_translations
site.description: List translations for the current site.

site.name: get_translation
site.description: Get a single translation by id.

site.name: create_translation
site.description: Create a new translation.

site.name: update_translation
site.description: Update an existing translation (partial PATCH).

site.name: delete_translation
site.description: Delete a translation. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: list_settings
site.description: List site settings, optionally filtered by scope.

site.name: get_setting
site.description: Get a single setting by key.

site.name: upsert_setting
site.description: Create or update a setting (upsert by key).

value.description: Arbitrary JSON value object for the setting.

site.name: delete_setting
site.description: Delete a setting by key. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: search
site.description: Full-text search within a collection. Returns ranked hits from the search backend. The `collection` parameter is required.

site.name: list_media
site.description: List media asset keys, optionally filtered by key prefix.

site.name: delete_media
site.description: Delete a media asset by key. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

key.description: Full storage key of the asset.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: list_transform_presets
site.description: List named image-transform presets available for media delivery (key + DSL).

site.name: list_tm
site.description: List translation-memory entries, optionally filtered by source/target language.

site.name: upsert_tm
site.description: Add or update a translation-memory entry.

site.name: lookup_tm
site.description: Fuzzy-match a query string against translation memory for a language pair.

site.name: translate_text
site.description: Run the full translation pipeline (TM + glossary + MT provider) for a text.

site.name: update_tm
site.description: Edit an existing translation-memory entry (partial PATCH).

site.name: delete_tm
site.description: Delete a translation-memory entry. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: list_dashboards
site.description: List insight dashboards for the current site.

site.name: get_dashboard
site.description: Get a single dashboard by id.

site.name: list_dashboard_panels
site.description: List the panels of a dashboard (their definitions, not the computed data).

site.name: run_panel
site.description: Run a saved panel and return its computed result. Optionally override the panel’s filter or date range for this run only (does not modify the panel).

filter.description: Override the panel filter for this run (Directus-style condition rule).

dateRange.description: Override the panel date range for this run.

site.name: query_insights
site.description: Ad-hoc aggregate query over a collection — no saved panel required. Answers operational questions (counts, sums, averages, breakdowns) directly. Read-only.

dashboardId.description: Any dashboard id you can access; the query runs ad-hoc and does not read that dashboard.

aggregate.description: Aggregate function. `field` is required for everything except `count`.

groupBy.description: Field to group rows by (produces a series).

dateRange.description: Restrict the query to a date window on the given field.

site.name: list_reviews
site.description: List the editorial review queue, optionally filtered by status or assignee.

site.name: submit_review
site.description: Submit an item for editorial review, optionally assigning a reviewer.

site.name: approve_content
site.description: Approve an item in editorial review (a publish-gate decision). Optional reason is audited.

site.name: reject_content
site.description: Reject an item in editorial review. Optional reason is audited.

site.name: list_releases
site.description: List content releases for the site, optionally filtered by status.

site.name: get_release
site.description: Get a single content release by id (with its staged items).

site.name: create_release
site.description: Create a content release. Set publishAt for a scheduled release; omit for a manual one.

publishAt.description: ISO datetime to auto-publish, or null.

site.name: update_release
site.description: Update a release and/or stage/unstage items (partial PATCH).

addItems.description: Items to stage into the release.

site.name: publish_release
site.description: Publish a release now (applies every staged item’s target status per the atomicity mode).

site.name: delete_release
site.description: Delete a content release. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: create_share
site.description: Create a scoped public share link for a single item, viewed through a given role.

roleId.description: Role whose permissions the link is viewed through.

site.name: revoke_share
site.description: Revoke a share link by id. DESTRUCTIVE — warn the user first and pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: get_my_permissions
site.description: Get the compiled permission bundle for the authenticated principal.

site.name: check_permission
site.description: Evaluate whether the current principal may perform an action on a collection (optionally against a specific item), returning { allowed, reason, fields }.

item.description: Item payload to evaluate row-level rules against.

site.name: list_roles
site.description: List roles for the current site.

site.name: get_role

site.name: create_role
site.description: Create a new role.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: attach_role_policy

site.name: detach_role_policy

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: assign_role_user
site.description: Assign a role to a user (sets the user's primary role for this site).

site.name: remove_role_user

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: detach_policy_user

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: export_access
site.description: Export the full RBAC manifest (roles, policies, permissions, bindings).

site.name: dry_run_access_import
site.description: Validate an RBAC manifest import without applying it. Returns the planned changes.

site.name: apply_access_import
site.description: Apply an RBAC manifest import. High-impact — changes roles/policies/permissions. Pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: check_access_conflicts
site.description: Check for permission conflicts before attaching/detaching policies on a target.

target.description: The role/user/api_key the policies would apply to.

site.name: list_api_keys

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation

site.name: detach_api_key_role
site.description: Detach a role from an API key. DESTRUCTIVE — pass confirm=true.

confirm.description: Must be true to confirm the destructive operation
